title: 3.9 Professions
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Recognize six jobs, ask What is your job? and say someone's job.
grammar_function: What is your job? I am a + job. He/She is a + job. Is he a driver? No, he is not.
speaking_outcome: Answer What is your job? and say what someone's job is.
